name: lean-tex-sync
description: Click a Lean line to highlight the LaTeX or PDF line named in its comment, and the other way around.

commands.title: Lean TeX: Open Side by Side
Lean TeX: Open PDF on the Left

leanTexSync.syncOnCursor.description: Highlight the other side when the cursor moves.

leanTexSync.synctexPath.description: Path to the synctex executable. Empty uses /Library/TeX/texbin/synctex when it exists, otherwise synctex on PATH.

leanTexSync.stampOnBuild.description: After a PDF build updates its SyncTeX file, write @pdf rectangles into Lean lines that already have @tex markers.

leanTexSync.highlightTex.description: Highlight the TeX source next to Lean when a Lean line is clicked. Focus stays on Lean.

leanTexSync.highlightPdf.description: Highlight the PDF when Lean or TeX is clicked. Use the box in an @pdf comment when one is present. Otherwise compute the position with SyncTeX.

scripts.test: tsc -p ./ && node --test out/parse.test.js out/pdfComment.test.js out/synctex.test.js out/links.test.js out/synctex.integration.test.js scripts/write-pdf-sync.test.mjs
